summary_md: **Eric D. Brown, D.Sc. ([@EricDBrownDsC](https://x.com/EricDBrownDsC/status/2115549189211894235))** covers **SWE-Residual**, a HKU-led benchmark that starts coding agents from another agent's "done" work that still fails hidden tests; five agents lost 20.6-53.5 points on DeepSWE.

referenced_urls.title: SWE-Residual: Evaluating Starting-State Robustness of Coding Agents

relevance: Measures robustness to inheriting broken agent work, a real multi-agent hand-off risk.
